title: General passport, version 1 (superseded) (general@1), public payload
description: general@1: the public payload carried on chain in field 10. JSON Schema validity is one check; obligation under a condition (needs-review), units, provenance and legal applicability are separate checks.

notice.description: The sample marker a demonstration record carries first; never product data.

profile.description: The profile identifier the payload declares.

profile_version.description: The profile version the payload declares; a reader decodes under it and never under a newer one.

object_did.description: An optional physical-object DID carried in the public payload; carrying it does not implement physical binding.

dataCarrier.description: The data-carrier identifier (chip UID) the lookup service indexes beside the passport identifier.
